Estimates

Janitorial & Cleaning Estimate Request

Tell us what you need, where the project is located, and your preferred timing. Add clear photos and a short walkthrough video to help the provider review the scope.

  • Demo only—nothing sent.
  • Photos and a short walkthrough video are normally needed before estimate readiness.
  • If you can’t provide media due to accessibility, technical problems, unsafe conditions, or an on-site assessment need, you can submit without it (marked “Awaiting project media”).
  • Upload guidance (when enabled): avoid people, personal documents, valuables, keys, entry codes, and unrelated private areas.
Estimate Disclaimer: The selected provider reviews your request and may provide a preliminary estimate, ask follow-up questions, or recommend an on-site assessment. The provider quotes and performs the work under its agreement with you. Submitting a request does not confirm a booking or final price.

Standards

Our Standards

Our planned approval process considers provider identity, relevant services, coverage, references, and applicable supporting documents. A published profile must accurately state what was reviewed and when. Paid advertising does not purchase a passing quality review.

  • Provider identity, services, and service-area coverage are reviewed before publication.
  • Profiles should show the review source (when provided) and the date evidence was checked.
  • Sponsored placement (when used) is labeled separately from approval status.
